ios.desc:
Plant Care is an all-in-one app for identifying plants and helping them thrive. Instantly identify plants from a photo, learn how to care for them, set watering reminders, and discover the ideal growing conditions for every plant. Whether you're new to houseplants or an experienced plant enthusiast, Plant Care provides the information you need to keep your plants healthy.

Features

• Identify plants from a photo or by using your camera.

• Browse detailed care guides, including watering, sunlight, temperature, humidity, soil, fertilizing, pruning, repotting, and propagation.

• Learn how to recognize and manage common plant pests and diseases.

• Set watering reminders to help keep every plant on schedule.

• Place realistic 3D plant models in your room using Augmented Reality to see how they'll look before you buy them.

• Save your favorite plants and automatically sync them across your Apple devices using iCloud.

• Access your saved plants and care guides even when you're offline.

Whether you're caring for a Monstera, Snake Plant, Pothos, Peace Lily, Fiddle Leaf Fig, Orchid, Succulent, Cactus, or many other houseplants, Plant Care makes plant care simple and enjoyable.
